name: design
description: No dependencies. `npm test` runs every skill's node:test suite and the CI scripts' (.github/test). `npm run pr-check` runs CI's pull-request-only checks against origin/main (or $BASE).

scripts.pr-check: base=${BASE:-origin/main}; node .github/duplicates.mjs "$base"; d=$?; node .github/exports.mjs "$base"; e=$?; exit $((d | e))
